fields.responsibility: Close the fixed-suite producer/lease/receipt and semantic index ownership interfaces and its complete six-module caller population. Use existing task ownership rather than requiring observations to have a directory named runs; admit only the exact bounded task/process pool root.
fields.retired: Retire label-based observation ownership, missing pool-root lease admission, private-cache lookup of an already tracked historical fixture and incomplete execute stubs that omitted their simulated completed lifecycle. No production quiescence or identity check is removed. Git parses proposal identity, including flags, intent-to-add and resolve-undo; stat-cache refresh is representation, not a proposal change.
fields.validation: Existing input-bound review_validation.run_suite:158 tests across all six whole modules, zero failures/errors/skips and zero changed inputs. Every Python implementation comes from one Git base plus selected files;619 declared data inputs, no native runtime copy. Real exclusive lease and foreign/nested/unrelated-root refusals; existing source invalidation, caps, early completion, payload and unknown-child assertions retained. Strict OpenSysML SDK and shared ASCENT gates/negative controls.
fields.benefits: Legitimate run and Recipe receipt paths share one owned fixed pool; CI consumers can reach their original Scheme assertions instead of failing on an artificial directory-name precondition. Actual producer and lease consumer ship together. Unselected dirty Python can no longer masquerade as this exact tested source cut. Repository fixture data replaces one private-cache dependency.
fields.costs: One existing owner check at receipt/pool admission, the existing identity-checked exclusive lease and fixed pool remain. One shared test-only completed-execute fixture replaces repeated incomplete stubs. Reuse one fixed Python audit source view,462 source files and619 declared data inputs; no native runtime clone, executor, profile, environment variable, heap or timeout change.
fields.process: CI custody support correction after admitted header build7f2ede96 and companion0017dabb; preserve independentSMP4/12 and eight open families. Exclude unrelated bootstrap/order assertions, Recipe relocations, archival/publication moves and all pending runtime proposals. Remote full-framework legacy failures stay retained and outside this scoped correction.
fields.models: GambitSuitePoolCustody is the SysML ownership source; the installed pinned OpenSysML SDK resolves its four declared components. Existing ASCENT gates bind exact source/test/model evidence and reject missing/stale obligations. No duplicate QNT or Lean runtime proof is added.
fields.open: No global CI-green, runtime speedup or new independent SMP-family claim. Historical-data availability, source-era mismatches, missing SysML CLI/platform qualification and unrelated full-framework failures remain separately enumerated. Vendor PR workflow triggering remains a platform observation, not a native pass. Eight later SMP families and all unverified Changes remain.
